evidence.S1: Light, dark, Traditional Chinese, Indonesian, and share sheet screens use consistent cards, spacing, and tabular numerals.
evidence.S2: both expenses are parsed live and saved when you stop talking; a toast offers Edit and Undo.
evidence.S3: Tapping a chart bar opens that day's expenses. Peak and average are labelled on the chart.
evidence.S4: Share card for day/week/month, Story or Square, 8 colour backgrounds, a transparent PNG sticker
evidence.S5: Works offline (service worker), CSV export, JSON backup/restore, last-backup date, storage-full warning

fixes: Add a brief review/confirm step or stronger undo for voice auto-save so accidental speech cannot silently create expenses.
Improve visual hierarchy in the share sheet, settings, and empty states: larger preview, less dense instructions, and more engaging empty-state design.
Add category drill-down and richer comparisons, such as week-over-week and category trends, to make summaries more actionable.

evidence.S1: Clean typography hierarchy, consistent bottom nav, good dark/light parity; minor rough edges: dark-mode 'Listening' state uses a simpler layout than the light-mode record sheet, and the Indonesian settings screen has dense text that crowds the card.
evidence.S2: 'Tap the mic and say lunch 120 and taxi 250 yesterday: both expenses are parsed live and saved when you stop talking; a toast offers Edit and Undo... Status reads Listening - 2 found while speaking; the mic pulses.' One-tap capture with live feedback, instant fix and undo.
evidence.S3: Overview shows total with '+10% vs same point last month', budget card with per-day allowance and month-end projection, spending-by-day chart with peak/average labels, category breakdown with percentages; 'Tapping a chart bar opens that day's expenses.' Story card adds budget-pace line, days-under-budget, logging streak.
evidence.S4: Day/week/month, Story or Square, 8 colour backgrounds, transparent PNG sticker with light/dark text, own photo, 'Hide amounts' percentages-only mode; the 1080x1920 Story card is poster-grade with clear hierarchy, budget-pace line, per-day/transactions/days-under-budget/streak grid, and category bars.
evidence.S5: 'Works offline (service worker), CSV export, JSON backup/restore, last-backup date, storage-full warning, persistent storage request.' Empty states shown ('No expenses yet', 'No expenses in this period') and 'No amount found' error state for voice input.

fixes: Unify the dark-mode capture/record sheet with the light-mode layout so the live parsed rows, category chips and amount fields appear identically in both themes.
Make empty states more visually engaging (illustration or subtle graphic) instead of plain text on the Overview, Activity and Budgets screens to guide first-time users.
Tighten the Indonesian (and other localized) Settings screen layout - the 'Wilayah', 'Bahasa aplikasi' and 'Tanya tanpa dengan Siri' cards look cramped; increase line-height or split into more cards.
